_about: config.json keys that are legitimately not fields of the model's config class (ROADMAP M3.2; moved from preflight.ELSEWHERE). Each entry says who reads the key instead, so the list stays a declaration and not a way to silence the check. Anything not listed is reported when the class does not take it and its value lands in no field the class knows (load.keys_taken). A dict value counts as taken when every value in it landed in a field the class knows (rope_scaling moved into rope_parameters).

read_elsewhere.cache_implementation: generation_config.json holds this one and GenerationConfig reads it (checked on a gemma-2-2b-it checkpoint)
read_elsewhere.bos_token_id: read for generation: GenerationConfig.from_model_config builds the generation settings from the config's to_dict(), which keeps a key the class did not declare (transformers 5.17 generation/configuration_utils.py, from_model_config)

read_elsewhere._name_or_path: where the checkpoint was loaded from, not a fact about the model
read_elsewhere.architectures: the loader picks the class from it before the config object exists
read_elsewhere.torch_dtype: read by from_pretrained, not stored as a config field
read_elsewhere.dtype: read by from_pretrained, not stored as a config field
read_elsewhere.quantization_config: read by the quantizer (transformers' quantizers, vLLM's and SGLang's quantization configs), not by the model's config class; its facts are read as Layout (readers.py)
read_elsewhere.auto_map: read by transformers' Auto classes to find a model's own code (trust_remote_code), not a field of the config class (seen on Phi-3.5-mini-instruct, M3.5)
read_elsewhere.attn_implementation: read by PreTrainedConfig itself (transformers 5.17 configuration_utils.py, __init__ and from_dict) and kept as _attn_implementation: which attention implementation runs (seen when from_pretrained is given attn_implementation, M3.5)
read_elsewhere.experts_implementation: read by PreTrainedConfig itself (transformers 5.17 configuration_utils.py, __init__ and from_dict) and kept as _experts_implementation
read_elsewhere.output_attentions: read by PreTrainedConfig itself (transformers 5.17 configuration_utils.py, __init__ and from_dict) and kept as _output_attentions
read_elsewhere.name_or_path: read by PreTrainedConfig itself (transformers 5.17 configuration_utils.py, __init__ and from_dict) and kept as _name_or_path
read_elsewhere.num_labels: read by PreTrainedConfig itself (transformers 5.17 configuration_utils.py, __init__ and from_dict), which builds id2label from it
read_elsewhere._commit_hash: read by PreTrainedConfig itself (transformers 5.17 configuration_utils.py, __init__ and from_dict): the hub revision the files came from
read_elsewhere.per_layer_config: read by PreTrainedConfig itself (transformers 5.17 configuration_utils.py, __init__ and from_dict) (HeterogeneousConfigMixin), which applies it per layer
